topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I arrived home to find a bouquet of flowers on my doorstep, wrapped neatly with no card in sight. The blooms were vibrant, a mix of daisies and lilies, their colors popping against the dull grey of the pavement. It’s a curious gesture, kind but puzzling. Whoever sent them knows my love for flowers, that’s for sure. I’ll probably ask around, maybe someone saw who delivered them. In the meantime, I’ll enjoy the unexpected beauty. They’ve certainly brightened up the living room.
